purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom Stronghold law profiles that require real Warcry execution. This records Stronghold faction-skill identity and Warcry-only semantics; it does not prove the native Warcry execution event, cooldown mutation, replacement school behavior, battle timing, or authorize gameplay mutation.
